1552687.steps:
1. Log into a Gen 7 firewall, navigate to Policy > Rules and Policies > Access rules
2. Click Grid settings and enable options (DPI client and DPI server) apply the filter
3. Add some access rules
4. Search a custom policy with the name and see if ther policy is displayed correctly
5. Add additional more grid settings and search for a custom policy
6. Try sorting the rules on the additional columns
1552687.title: Verify filtering the access rules works fine after adding custom columns under Grid Settings
1552687.result:
Step 4 & 5: The policy is displayed correctly
Step 6: Able to sort the rules on additional columns.

3638302.steps:
1. Assign two interfaces like X3(LAN), X4(WLAN)
2. Go to access rule page
3. Try to create a custom access rule with interface based, e.g. from X3 to X4
4. in optional settings page, enable 'Create Reflexive Rule'
5. Check the created policies
3638302.title: Verify correct reflexive rule can be added when option 'Create Reflexive Rule' is enabled
3638302.result: Reflexive rule should be reversed, e.g. (from X4 to X3).
